query:
SELECT
            COALESCE((
                SELECT SUM(amount)
                FROM payouts_values
                WHERE user_id = $1 AND date_available <= NOW()
            ), 0)::numeric AS "earned!",
            COALESCE((
                SELECT SUM(amount)
                FROM payouts_values
                WHERE user_id = $1
                  AND date_available <= NOW()
                  AND amount > 0
            ), 0)::numeric AS "positive_earned!",
            COALESCE((
                SELECT SUM(amount)
                FROM payouts
                WHERE user_id = $1 AND status IN ('success', 'in-transit')
            ), 0)::numeric AS "withdrawn!",
            COALESCE((
                SELECT SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN method = 'yunzhanghu_alipay' THEN 0
                        ELSE COALESCE(fee, 0)
                    END
                )
                FROM payouts
                WHERE user_id = $1 AND status IN ('success', 'in-transit')
            ), 0)::numeric AS "old_channel_fees!"
